scenarios.name: Navigate to Client Registration page via Join Healing Sky.
scenarios.criteria: Clicking 'Join Healing Sky' in the main navigation and selecting 'Join as a Client' opens the client registration page.

scenarios.name: Fill client registration form excluding referral code and submission.
scenarios.criteria: The fields 'Full Name', 'Email', 'Phone Number', 'Date of Birth', and 'Address Lookup' retain their values after being entered. The 'Referral Code' field remains empty.
scenarios.endState: Client registration form is completed, except for the 'Referral Code' field.

scenarios.name: Complete client registration by filling Referral Code and submitting.
scenarios.criteria: Submit the client registration form and confirm registration succeeds if either the success confirmation message is displayed or the application navigates to the client login page.
preconditions: Client registration form (excluding 'Referral Code') is completed.
scenarios.startState: Client registration page is displayed with all fields filled, except 'Referral Code'.
scenarios.endState: Client is registered and either sees a success confirmation or is redirected to the client login page.

scenarios.name: Navigate to client OTP authentication screen.
scenarios.criteria: Using the configured client email and selecting Email as the OTP delivery method, clicking 'Log in' displays the OTP verification interface.
scenarios.endState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.

scenarios.name: Successfully log in as a client using configured OTP bypass value.
scenarios.criteria: Successful login is achieved if the sign-in success message 'OTP verified successfully' is displayed or an authenticated client page under '/client/' is loaded. The test also passes if redirected to '/client/dashboard'.
preconditions: Client OTP verification interface is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.
scenarios.endState: Client dashboard or another authenticated client page is displayed.

scenarios.name: Log out from authenticated client dashboard.
scenarios.criteria: Client is signed out and returned to the Healing Sky homepage with the 'Log in' option visible again.
preconditions: Client is authenticated on the dashboard.
scenarios.endState: Client is signed out and Healing Sky homepage is displayed.

scenarios.name: Navigate to Provider Registration wizard.
scenarios.criteria: From the Healing Sky homepage, clicking 'Join Healing Sky' and selecting 'List as a Provider' opens the provider registration wizard.
scenarios.endState: Provider registration wizard at /provider/register is displayed.

scenarios.name: Fill Provider Wizard Step 1 - Personal Details.
scenarios.criteria: All fields in step 1 are populated successfully with their values retained, and the form proceeds to /provider/address.
preconditions: Provider registration wizard at /provider/register is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Provider registration wizard (Step 1: Personal Details) is displayed.

scenarios.name: Fill Provider Wizard Step 2 - Address Details.
scenarios.criteria: The Address Lookup resolves and other fields like Country auto-fill correctly. The step passes if the form proceeds to /provider/location.
preconditions: Provider registration wizard at /provider/address is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Provider registration wizard (Step 2: Address) is displayed.

scenarios.name: Fill Provider Wizard Step 3 - Provider and Listing Details.
scenarios.criteria: All fields in step 3 are filled successfully with their values retained, and the form proceeds to /provider/credential.
preconditions: Provider registration wizard at /provider/location is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Provider registration wizard (Step 3: Provider and Listing Details) is displayed.

scenarios.name: Fill Provider Wizard Step 4 - License Status.
scenarios.criteria: The selected option is 'I am licensed', and the form proceeds to /provider/credentials.
preconditions: Provider registration wizard at /provider/credential is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Provider wizard step 4 (license status) is displayed.

scenarios.name: Fill Provider Wizard Step 5 - License Details.
scenarios.criteria: License details are filled and validated. The step completes successfully once the wizard proceeds to /provider/billing.
preconditions: Provider wizard license details page at /provider/credentials is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Provider wizard step 5 (license details) is displayed.

scenarios.name: Select Provider Wizard Step 6 - Plan Selection.
scenarios.criteria: The 'Standard Account' plan is selected and the wizard successfully navigates to the payment screen at /provider/card.
preconditions: Provider wizard plan selection page at /provider/billing is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Provider wizard step 6 (plan selection) is displayed.

scenarios.name: Complete Provider Wizard Step 7 - Payment.
scenarios.criteria: Payment is confirmed if a success or confirmation message is displayed or the application navigates to the provider dashboard, onboarding-complete, or thank-you page.
preconditions: Provider Payment page at /provider/card is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Provider wizard step 7 (payment page) is displayed.
scenarios.endState: Payment is successful and provider redirects to the appropriate page after payment.
